name: agent-companion
description: Delegate from Codex CLI to OpenCode, GitHub Copilot CLI, Codex CLI, Google Antigravity or Claude Code. Codex starts a thread with your task and an absolute repo or worktree path, follows up in that thread, and brings the result back to your conversation.

interface.shortDescription: Start companion threads and receive answers in Codex.
interface.longDescription: The Codex lead sends your task directly to OpenCode, GitHub Copilot CLI, Codex CLI, Google Antigravity or Claude Code. A new thread takes an absolute repo or worktree path and returns its id at once. Follow up in that thread, send input while it runs, or keep working until the result arrives. The lead can also wait, read long answers in pages and cancel a job.
defaultPrompt: Ask Claude Code to review the changes in this worktree and flag bugs with file references.
Follow up in the same companion thread and ask which check would confirm the finding.
List my companion threads and read the latest answer.
